business_problem: Match Group needed to remove language, skill, and knowledge barriers inside a global product organization while also accelerating AI-powered product development for its dating platforms.
solution_summary: Match Group is pairing ChatGPT Enterprise with the OpenAI API so AI improves both internal collaboration and the product roadmap behind brands like Tinder, Hinge, and OkCupid. The company rolled ChatGPT Enterprise out to thousands of employees, where product managers, designers, and engineers now use it for technical collaboration, translation, documentation, bug fixing, API design, rapid prototyping, and custom GPT-based knowledge sharing. Designers also use GPT-4 multimodal capabilities to simulate usability testing from wireframes while product teams are exploring OpenAI API features that can help users create deeper, more authentic profiles with less effort. In operational terms, prompts, wireframes, internal documentation, and product ideas move into AI tools, and the resulting prototypes, translations, or decisions feed directly back into collaboration and product work. That has turned AI into both a workforce-enablement layer and a foundation for future customer-facing features.
